description: Tafwid hooks: the completion wait for delegated workers, and the opt-in activity log for the local Tafwid dashboard (off until you run world.py on).

hooks.command: bash -c ': "Tafwid: before ending the turn, wait for a delegated worker to finish."; exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/delegate/scripts/completion_hook.py" hook'

bash -c ': "Tafwid activity log: notes which agents are working and on what, for the local Tafwid dashboard. Does nothing unless you switch it on."; [ -f "${TAFWID_HOME:-$HOME/.tafwid}/state/world/enabled" ] || exit 0; exec python3 -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/delegate/scripts/world_hook.py"'

bash -c ': "Tafwid: stop waiting for delegated workers when you interrupt or send a new message."; exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/delegate/scripts/completion_hook.py" disarm'
